scope: Offline API compatibility on generated speech; not a meeting-accuracy benchmark.
hardware: NVIDIA RTX 5090 Laptop GPU, 24 GB; driver 615.71.09
gpu_launcher: GPU-sharing launcher: 85% of GPU threads, CPU nice +5, low I/O priority
network_policy: Predownloaded pinned local artifacts, HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1, TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1, HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1, PYANNOTE_METRICS_ENABLED=0. No audio uploaded.
prewarm_policy: Initialize maximum decoder batch before capture, then replace all session speaker/decoder state and reset step to zero. Warmup samples are excluded from the recording clock and transcript.
